The furnished apartment in Dhaka fetcher
Furnished apartments in Dhaka are available through various online platforms, including popular real estate websites and services. Popular neighborhoods for furnished apartments include Gulshan, Banani, Baridhara, and Dhanmondi. Rental prices can range from BDT 120,000 to BDT 470,000 per month, depending on factors like apartment size, location, and the amenities offered.
Popular Areas:
Gulshan: Known for its luxury and modern amenities.
Banani: A prestigious area with a mix of residential and commercial properties.
Baridhara: A more exclusive neighborhood, often favored by expatriates.
Dhanmondi: A well-established area with a mix of older and newer apartments.
Where to Find Furnished Apartments:
Online Real Estate Platforms: Websites and apps dedicated to property listings provide a variety of options, including details on price, location, and amenities.
Airbnb: This platform can be a good option for both short-term stays and monthly rentals.
Brokerage Services: Real estate agents or brokers can help you find suitable apartments within your desired area and budget.
Factors Affecting Price:
Size: Larger apartments tend to have higher rental prices.
Location: Areas with more developed infrastructure, facilities, and amenities generally come with higher prices.
Amenities: Luxury features like swimming pools, gyms, and 24/7 security services can lead to an increase in rental costs.
Furnishings: The quality and extent of furniture in an apartment can also impact its rent.
Luxury vs. Standard: Luxury apartments, often with higher-end finishes and additional services, typically demand a premium compared to standard apartments.
Affordable Living in Dhaka:
Despite impressive economic growth, Dhaka remains one of the most expensive cities in terms of cost of living when compared to many other developed cities worldwide.
Developers in Dhaka are increasingly leaning toward building larger, smarter, and greener apartments to meet growing demand. Some of the most luxurious developments, like those in areas such as Gulshan, set high price points, but they cater to a niche market seeking top-tier living standards.

Furnished Apartments in Gulshan, Dhaka
Price Range & Options
Typical monthly rents range from BDT 80,000 to 450,000, depending on size, amenities, and location within Gulshan. sharif.com.bd
Examples:
• A 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom (2,200 sq ft) fully furnished apartment: ~BDT 150,000/month. Sharif.com.bd
• A 3 BHK serviced apartment (3,300 sq ft) with premium amenities: ~BDT 180,000/month. Sharif.com.bd
• A luxury 4 bed/5 bath, 4,758 sq ft apartment: ~BDT 450,000/month, upper-tier luxury. Sharif.com.bd
For smaller units:
• A fully furnished unit: Tk 110,000/month, negotiable.
• Another listing: Tk 150,000/month for a fully furnished apartment. sharif.com.bd
________________________________________
Platforms & Listings - sharif.com.bd
• Local property management agencies showcase a variety of furnished and serviced apartments, with different layouts and pricing tiers.
• Online platforms offer direct peer listings with negotiable prices (e.g. Tk 110K or Tk 150K).
• Classified sites feature numerous listings, categorized by price brackets—under Tk 86K, Tk 86–130K, Tk 130–190K, and over Tk 190K—showing a wide variety of furnished apartments with 3–4 bedrooms, balconies, hot water, Wi-Fi, and more.
________________________________________
Recommendations & Tips
Define your needs first:
• Bedrooms needed (1–3 BHK is common).
• Desired area (Gulshan-1 vs. Gulshan-2 may differ in vibe and price).
• Preferred amenities (gym, pool, parking, security, housekeeping).
• Comfortable budget range.
Where to search:
• Use real estate agencies for curated, service-assisted listings.
• Browse online platforms for peer listings—often negotiable.
• Check local social platforms or marketplace listings.
Safety & community:
• Gulshan is generally considered expat-friendly and safer compared to many other areas in Dhaka.
• Still, avoid walking alone late at night.
Prepare for extras:
• Many apartments do not include utility bills (electricity, water, gas, internet) in the rent.
• Deposits are typically 1–2 months’ rent.
